The Residence

Living spaces with a regal rhythm

Rising above Bukit Jalil, The Queenswoodz holds a curated collection of 1,004 private residences across two sculpted towers — Tower A with 494 units and Tower B with 510.

Five layouts run from a smartly planned 807 sq ft 2+1 bedroom, through 936 sq ft and 1,206 sq ft family homes, up to two 1,410 sq ft configurations — a four-bedroom and a 3+1 bedroom dual-key designed for multi-generational living or a separated home office.

Every type carries a refined material palette, interiors drawn toward natural light, and a plan that moves gracefully from private rest to shared connection.

Why The Queenswoodz

Grace above, roots below

The things that actually shape daily life here — with the distances I have measured myself.

480 m to the LRT

LRT Awan Besar is roughly 480 m from the door, for direct access into greater Kuala Lumpur.

Novel Park, 180 m away

A landscaped green sanctuary about 180 m from the lobby — scenic paths and open space, not just a view of them.

A dual-key option

Type D2 splits 1,410 sq ft into a 3+1 bedroom home plus a self-contained studio — family, guests or home office.

Sky decks on 50 & 51

Sky BBQ and Moonlight Sip lounges crown Tower A at Level 50 and Tower B at Level 51.

GreenRE development

EXSIM builds to GreenRE standards — the national hallmark for sustainable buildings and townships.

Retail from 35 m

THE LINK Bukit Jalil is about 35 m away, Aurora Place 550 m and Pavilion Bukit Jalil with the City retail about 700 m — schools and medical centres follow within a few kilometres.

Three facility levels

Arrival lounges at ground, a 16-element podium deck on Level 8, and the Momentum Studio on Level 9.

Room to grow

2+1 to 4 bedrooms, 807 to 1,410 sq ft — one address that still fits when the family changes shape.

Before You Ask

The questions that come up first

In Bukit Jalil City, Kuala Lumpur. Measured from the development: THE LINK Bukit Jalil about 35 m, Novel Park about 180 m, Bukit Jalil Recreational Park about 250 m, LRT Awan Besar about 480 m, Aurora Place about 550 m and Pavilion Bukit Jalil with the City retail about 700 m. Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort is 1.3 km and Mid Valley Megamall 7.5 km. The full list, including schools, hospitals and campuses, is in the Location section above.

EXSIM — the project entity is EXSIM Bukit Jalil Link Sdn. Bhd. (Registration No. 201401009297 / 1368455-U). EXSIM builds to GreenRE standards, the national hallmark for sustainable buildings and townships.

1,004 residences across two towers — Tower A holds 494 units and Tower B holds 510. Sky facilities sit on Level 50 of Tower A and Level 51 of Tower B.

Five types: Type A at 807 sq ft (2+1 bedrooms, 2 baths), Type B at 936 sq ft (3 bed, 2 bath), Type C at 1,206 sq ft (3+1 bed, 3 bath), Type D1 at 1,410 sq ft (4 bed, 3 bath) and Type D2 — also 1,410 sq ft — as a 3+1 bedroom dual-key. Types A, B and C each come with and without a balcony.

Type D2 divides its 1,410 sq ft into a main 3+1 bedroom home and a self-contained studio with its own bathroom and entrance. Families use it for elderly parents or grown children, and others use it to keep a home office fully separate from living space.

The price list moves with what is left on the stack and with the launch package, so I don’t publish it here — and I won’t quote a tenure or a completion date from anything other than the developer’s own approved documents. Register above or message me on WhatsApp and I’ll send you the current set, straight from the developer.

Yes. Viewings run at the EXSIM Millerz Square Sales Gallery, G-08 Ground Floor, Megan Legasi, No. 357 Jalan Kelang Lama, 58000 Kuala Lumpur. Message me and I'll arrange a slot and meet you there.
